events.title: EDVD + Xanax
events.notes: 250-hit chain focused on steady participation and maintaining the timer. Please arrive with energy stacked and targets prepared. Follow live instructions in Discord, call out any availability issues early, and avoid taking bonus hits unless assigned by the chain lead.
expectations: Prepare a list of suitable targets
Have Xanax and points available if required
Join Discord before the opening call
Check that you are out of hospital and jail
Avoid unnecessary attacks before the chain
Watch the chain timer between hits
